newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILNIAUS LEASING ASSETS UP TO 45 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: VILNIAUS LEASING ASSETS UP TO 45 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Vilniaus Bank said on Monday that the assets of its leasing firm rose to 45 million litas at the end of June from 21 million litas at the beginning of the year.
The bank also said in a statement that the net leasing portfolio of its leasing firm stood at 34.4 million litas at the end of June compared to 12.7 million litas at the start of the year.
The bank said that it has signed 450 leasing agreements over the past two years, 250 of them during the first half of 1997.
It added that the profit figures of the company for the first half of the year will be released before the end of the month.
Vilniaus Bank Leasing posted a profit of 37,600 litas in 1996.
